description: Get the score history for a domain as a whole, newest first, up to an optional `limit` (default 20, max 100 -- pass a smaller limit like 3-5 to save context window tokens) -- the site-level counterpart to get_page_scores, same relationship as get_site_issues is to get_page_issues. This is the pooled job/site score (every check in the scan, not just one page), not a per-page average -- use get_page_scores for one page's own trend instead.
name: get_site_history
title: Get site history
